title: Assignment 03 · Consideration and formalities
summary: Consideration and formalities. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Hamer v. Sidway: Requested surrender of lawful freedom can supply consideration even when the promisee benefits from abstaining and the promisor receives no measurable economic gain.

Dyer v. National By-Products, Inc.: An invalid claim can still support a settlement through good-faith forbearance. Whether Dyer honestly held the claim remained a factual question, so summary judgment was premature.

Tolosa v. HSBC Bank USA, N.A.: The alleged oral promise to delay foreclosure fell within the Texas loan-agreement writing requirement, and the pleaded reliance did not satisfy the specific estoppel exception applied by the court.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement §§ 71, 79, 81; N.Y. General Obligations Law § 5-1105; CISG Article 11.
